headers.Access-Control-Allow-Methods: DELETE, GET, HEAD, OPTIONS, PATCH, POST, PUT

note: contract change: all OPTIONS responses are 204 with an empty body (previously 200). A CORS preflight (Origin + Access-Control-Request-Method) traverses the router and rides the same 204; the after-request CORS layer appends the CORS response headers for the allowed origin list with credentials support. A 204 carries no Content-Length.
